topography.project_purpose: Shadow Exchange is a decentralized exchange (DEX) on the Sonic chain that facilitates token swaps, liquidity provision, and yield farming. It offers both a classic automated market maker (AMM) model and a concentrated liquidity model, along with governance and fee distribution mechanisms.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Core and Concentrated Liquidity families share the Shadow token for incentives and governance, with fee distribution and voting contracts bridging both. Access Control contracts govern upgrades and parameters across all families via proxy admin ownership.
